# Data Dictionary

*Generated by `src/data_dictionary.py` from the loaded data. Do not edit numbers by hand.*

## Dataset overview

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Source | Kaggle, "Zomato Restaurants Data" by Shruti Mehta (secondary data) |
| Licence | **CC0: Public Domain** (as stated on the Kaggle dataset page) |
| Files | `zomato.csv`, `Country-Code.xlsx` |
| Encoding | `latin-1` (file is not valid UTF-8) |
| Rows | 9,551 |
| Columns in input file | 21 |
| Columns after country join | 22 |
| Countries | 15 |
| Cities | 141 |
| Date / opening-year column | **None** (no time dimension) |
| Restaurant-type column | **None** |

## Columns

| Raw name | Clean name | Type (raw) | Description | Example values | Missing | Unique | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Restaurant ID | `restaurant_id` | Int64 | Zomato's unique identifier for the restaurant. | 6317637; 6304287; 6300002 | 0 | 9,551 | Primary key. Verified unique. |
| Restaurant Name | `restaurant_name` | string | Name of the restaurant. | Le Petit Souffle; Izakaya Kikufuji; Heat - Edsa Shangri-La | 0 | 7,446 | Not unique: chains appear many times. Some names contain garbled accented characters from the source file (e.g. 'Cafí©' for 'Café'). |
| Country Code | `country_code` | Int64 | Numeric country code used by Zomato. | 162; 30; 216 | 0 | 15 | Join key to Country-Code.xlsx. |
| Country | `country` | string | Country name, joined from Country-Code.xlsx. | Phillipines; Brazil; United States | 0 | 15 | Not in zomato.csv. Known misspellings (e.g. 'Phillipines') corrected in cleaning; codes missing from the lookup become 'Unknown'. |
| City | `city` | string | City where the restaurant is located. | Makati City; Mandaluyong City; Pasay City | 0 | 141 | A few names garbled in source (e.g. 'Sí£o Paulo', 'ÛÁstanbul'). |
| Address | `address` | string | Full street address. | Third Floor, Century City Mall, Kalayaan Avenue, Poblacion, Makati City; Little Tokyo, 2277 Chino Roces Avenue, Legaspi Village, Makati City; Edsa Shangri-La, 1 Garden Way, Ortigas, Mandaluyong City | 0 | 8,918 | Free text. |
| Locality | `locality` | string | Neighbourhood / area within the city. | Century City Mall, Poblacion, Makati City; Little Tokyo, Legaspi Village, Makati City; Edsa Shangri-La, Ortigas, Mandaluyong City | 0 | 1,208 | Free text; used for area analysis. |
| Locality Verbose | `locality_verbose` | string | Locality followed by city. | Century City Mall, Poblacion, Makati City, Makati City; Little Tokyo, Legaspi Village, Makati City, Makati City; Edsa Shangri-La, Ortigas, Mandaluyong City, Mandaluyong City | 0 | 1,265 | Mostly redundant with locality + city. |
| Longitude | `longitude` | float64 | Longitude in decimal degrees. | 121.027535; 121.014101; 121.056831 | 0 | 8,120 | Some rows are (0, 0) = missing; see quality report. |
| Latitude | `latitude` | float64 | Latitude in decimal degrees. | 14.565443; 14.553708; 14.581404 | 0 | 8,677 | Some rows are (0, 0) = missing; see quality report. |
| Cuisines | `cuisines` | string | Comma-separated list of cuisines served. | French, Japanese, Desserts; Japanese; Seafood, Asian, Filipino, Indian | 9 | 1,825 | Exploded into restaurant_cuisines.csv (one row per restaurant-cuisine pair). |
| Average Cost for two | `avg_cost_for_two` | int64 | Typical cost of a meal for two people. | 1100; 1200; 4000 | 0 | 140 | In LOCAL currency (see currency). Do not compare raw values across countries; use price_range, or the derived avg_cost_for_two_usd (approximate, World Bank 2017 rates, see docs/currency_and_costs.md). |
| Currency | `currency` | string | Currency of avg_cost_for_two. | Botswana Pula(P); Brazilian Real(R$); Dollar($) | 0 | 12 | Philippines rows are labelled 'Botswana Pula(P)' in source (source error). 'Dollar($)' is shared by Australia, Canada, Singapore and US (different dollars). |
| Has Table booking | `has_table_booking` | str | Whether table booking is offered (Yes/No). | Yes; No | 0 | 2 | Converted to 1/0. |
| Has Online delivery | `has_online_delivery` | str | Whether online delivery is offered (Yes/No). | No; Yes | 0 | 2 | Converted to 1/0. |
| Is delivering now | `is_delivering_now` | string | Whether delivering at the moment the data was scraped (Yes/No). | No; Yes | 0 | 2 | Snapshot-in-time flag; converted to 1/0. |
| Switch to order menu | `switch_to_order_menu` | string | Whether the 'switch to order menu' option is shown (Yes/No). | No | 0 | 1 | Converted to 1/0. Constant in this file (single value) - carries no information. |
| Price range | `price_range` | Int64 | Zomato price band, 1 (cheapest) to 4 (most expensive). | 3; 4; 2 | 0 | 4 | Comparable across countries; preferred over cost for cross-country analysis. |
| Aggregate rating | `aggregate_rating` | float64 | Average user rating, 0-5 scale. | 4.8; 4.5; 4.4 | 0 | 33 | 0 together with rating_text 'Not rated' means MISSING, not a real zero. |
| Rating color | `rating_color` | string | Colour band shown for the rating. | Dark Green; Green; Yellow | 0 | 6 | Fully determined by aggregate_rating (derived field). |
| Rating text | `rating_text` | string | Text band for the rating (Poor ... Excellent, Not rated). | Excellent; Very Good; Good | 0 | 6 | Fully determined by aggregate_rating (derived field). |
| Votes | `votes` | Int64 | Number of user votes/ratings received. | 314; 591; 270 | 0 | 1,012 | Highly right-skewed. |

## Derived files

- `data/processed/zomato_clean.csv`: one row per restaurant, snake_case columns above plus cleaning flags.
- `data/processed/restaurant_cuisines.csv`: one row per (restaurant_id, cuisine) pair.
